entries.claim: A fresh x86_64 remote Linux clone installed the candidate bootstrap tools and passed every scaffold check.

A fresh simulated orb installed the pinned repository toolchain in under two minutes; repeated setup and resume reused it without installation, and a minimal login shell passed every repository check.

The dependency-free runtime_lab application reported the exact pinned OTP 29.0.5 / ERTS 17.0.5 / Elixir 1.20.4 host identity, passed 10 tests twice without network access, preserved state across an intentional worker restart, escalated a four-crash storm past its configured restart intensity, reproduced deterministic bounded workload results, booted under controlled mix run --no-halt shutdown, and assembled an ERTS-free release payload with no native libraries.
Two fresh network-disabled Linux builders produced matching complete toolchain metadata, and the sealed OTP 29.0.5/Elixir 1.20.4 pair built and ran the reference Mix application offline.

The exact pinned runtime_lab workload produced two equal normalized host traces; revision 0 classifies all 91 host and target interactions against 18 sealed OTP/musl source items; and full-system AArch64-musl probes cover the required error, timeout, cancellation, signal, thread-lifecycle, and shutdown paths with no unexplained calls.

The pinned official OTP 29.0.5 flow produced a static non-JIT AArch64-musl release whose complete 23-object native closure passed sealed ELF/CPU/load audits and matched a second clean rebuild exactly.

The exact static non-JIT AArch64-musl ERTS artifact passed one smoke boot and ten fresh full-system QEMU TCG acceptance boots with minimal, single-scheduler, and final two-scheduler workload progress, complete platform/runtime capture, clean shutdown, no dynamic or unrecorded host dependency, and all 53 syscalls mapped to beam-host revision 0.

Two fresh genuine Mix release builds paired reproducibly with the exact static AArch64-musl OTP 29.0.5 / ERTS 17.0.5 artifact, then passed ten read-only full-system AArch64 Linux boots through the direct beam.smp manifest with exact Elixir 1.20.4 identity, normal application behavior, no undeclared writes or native substitutions, and clean shutdown.

The independent no_std AArch64 probe passed ten fresh QEMU 11.1.0 TCG boots while discovering the PCI platform, presenting two checked virtio GPU frames, receiving scripted absolute pointer and button input, and exercising the audited VirtIO status, queue, reset, interrupt, DMA, malformed-command, and teardown contracts.

The pinned Tyn source, committed ERTS ELF, architecture differences, limitations, and corrected futex history were audited; its kernel rebuilt; unavailable KVM execution was recorded without TCG substitution; and the Linux liveness probe passed while detecting five injected thread-progress failures.
